correctness.rationale: Exact free-Lamperti transform plus independent Poisson renewal determines one real cumulant root. Positive exponentially tilted nonarithmetic renewal kernel yields the rigorous log-growth limit. Implicit derivatives establish strictly positive curvature and analyticity, and bounded support permits the full differentiable Gärtner-Ellis LDP. The explicit root has e_k asymptotic r^(1/(1-mu))*k^(-mu/(1-mu)); Legendre optimization gives the stated edge coefficient. Independent numerical quadrature and exact Brownian identities corroborate normalization and limits.

value.rationale: The source identifies only the central Gaussian regime for occupation under Poisson resetting, whereas this result quantifies exponentially rare nearly one-sided trajectories for every sluggishness exponent. The sharp delta^mu cusp and computable whole rate curve capture physically observable differences in transport classes that the Gaussian approximation cannot provide, and are not arbitrary narrow parameters.
